lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) _ (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have hp :=
    real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx)
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hn, hφ⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset
    (hc.continuousAt.eventually (le_mem_nhds hp))
  have hz := hg _
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hd, hk⟩ (contDiff_const (c := f x₀)))
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  refine ne_of_gt ((hd.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hk.mul_right ?_ (mul_ne_zero (hφ.trans_ne one_ne_zero) hp.ne')) hz
  intro x
  by_cases hx : φ x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  · apply mul_nonneg (hn (Set.mem_range_self x)).1
    exact hs (subset_closure hx)

theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)  := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f n := (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ := (Set.finite_Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (f := f) (by intro n; simp_all only [f, Set.mem_Icc, Prod.mk_le_mk, and_self])
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hij.le
  refine ⟨i, c, Nat.pos_of_lt_add_right hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  suffices f (n + c) = f n from congrArg Prod.fst this
  refine Nat.leRecOn hn ?_ he.symm
  intro n ih
  simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq, Nat.succ_add] at ih ⊢
  refine ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ) ?_⟩
  clear hB he
  grind -ring -linarith only

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable (by decide)
  have hEs j := electricField_apply_contDiff_space (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c)
    (i := j) (hA.of_le (by decide)) t
  have hEd j := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j)
  have hBs j := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) A
    (n := 2) (hA.of_le (by decide)) (j, i)
  have hs := congrArg (fderiv ℝ · x (Space.basis i))
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hs
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,
    fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => hEd j j x,
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      hJd t x),
    _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
    Space.deriv_commute (u := i) _ (hEs _)] at hs
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) _),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    (((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun j _ =>
      (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (hBs j) x t).hasFDerivAt).const_mul _).fun_sub
      ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
        hJd x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _)).fderiv]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq, Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hBs _),
    time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out),
    Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd _ _) (hEd _ _),
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hs, mul_sub, FreeSpace.c_sq,
    mul_comm 𝓕.μ₀ 𝓕.ε₀, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_inv, mul_assoc,
    inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)

    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  have hi : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_i_add_steps⟩ - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
      BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩ - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, Nat.sub_add_eq, pow_sub_mul_pow _
        (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (Nat.le_add_right_of_le h_i_add_steps)),
      Nat.sub_add_eq, pow_sub_mul_pow _ (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)]
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  let Y (g : C) := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val
  obtain ⟨g, -, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := (fun g => (Y g).ncard) '' Set.univ)
    (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  have hb := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)
  rw [fiberwiseDistance, ← hg] at hb
  let d := hammingDist f g.val
  have hd : d ≤ (Y g).ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← Finset.card_fin (2 ^ steps), ← Finset.card_product]
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p =>
      qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, lt_trans i.isLt (lt_of_add_right_lt h_ℓ_add_R_rate)⟩
        steps (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2)
    intro x hx

    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc] at h
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hb)).trans_eq hi)
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (b := (2 * d : ℕ∞))
  · apply (ENat.mul_le_mul_left_iff _root_.two_ne_zero (ENat.coe_ne_top 2)).mpr

theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  simp only [← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not] at *
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, ← Fintype.card_set]
  apply (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP).mp
  clear hPP
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val  := by
  intro P f g cs Q y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let E := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let O := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hp (k : Fin 2) : P.eval (x k).val = E.eval y.val + (x k).val * O.eval y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
    rfl
  have hQ : Q.eval y.val = (1 - r_chal) * E.eval y.val + r_chal * O.eval y.val := by
    dsimp only [Q, cs, E, O, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
      mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  dsimp only [g, fold, f]
  rw [hp, hp, hQ]
  simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y, Fin2ToF2,
    Ne.symm (Fin.zero_ne_one (n := 0)), ↓reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
    Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let t := (ι (𝓕 := 𝓕)).toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF
  rw [map_mul ι]
  change t _ = _ * t _
  rw [← ofCrAnListFBasis.linearCombination_repr a,
    ← ofCrAnListFBasis.linearCombination_repr b]
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_mul,
    Finset.mul_sum, map_sum, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul,
    ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro φs _
  apply congrArg (_ • ·)
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro φs' _
  apply congrArg (_ • ·)
  let e := fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
  obtain ⟨l1, l2, ht⟩ : ∃ l1 l2 : 𝓕.WickAlgebra,
      ∀ l, (∀ c ∈ l, e c) →
      t (ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ l ++ φs)) =
      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ l ++ φs) • (l1 * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * l2) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    rotate_left 2
    intro l hl
    change ι 𝓣ᶠ(_) = _
    rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, crAnTimeOrderList,
      insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ _ _ _ hl]
    simp only [map_smul, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul]
    rw [mul_assoc]
  trans crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
    (l1 * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * l2)
  · rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
    simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
      map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
      List.singleton_append]
    rw [ht [φ, ψ] (by simp [e, hφψ, hψφ]), ht [ψ, φ] (by simp [e, hφψ, hψφ])]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_sub, smul_comm]
  · specialize ht [] (by simp)
    simp only [List.append_nil, ofCrAnListF_nil, map_one, mul_one] at ht
    rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, ht, Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp $
      ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ]
    by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign,
        Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm, ← crAnTimeOrderSign]
      simp only [mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
